content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-318. - I.F.G.C. Section 101.1, Title.
content.summary:
Section 101.1. Title,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"101.1. Title.
These regulations shall be known as the
Fuel Gas Code
of the City of Arvada, hereinafter referred to as "this code.""
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 9, 9-14-2020)
